CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS eventos_perdas (

    evento_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES eventos(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    produto_nome TEXT NOT NULL,

);

-- Add RLS policies
ALTER TABLE eventos_perdas ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Allow authenticated users to view all event losses
CREATE POLICY "Allow authenticated users to view event losses"
    ON eventos_perdas
    FOR SELECT
    TO authenticated
    USING (true);

-- Allow authenticated users to insert event losses
CREATE POLICY "Allow authenticated users to insert event losses"
    ON eventos_perdas
    FOR INSERT
    TO authenticated
    WITH CHECK (true);

-- Allow users to delete their own event losses
CREATE POLICY "Allow users to delete own event losses"
    ON eventos_perdas
    FOR DELETE
    TO authenticated
    USING (auth.uid() = user_id);

-- Create index for faster queries
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_eventos_perdas_evento_id ON eventos_perdas(evento_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_eventos_perdas_created_at ON eventos_perdas(created_at DESC);

-- Add trigger to update updated_at

RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    NEW.updated_at = NOW();
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER trigger_update_eventos_perdas_updated_at
    BEFORE UPDATE ON eventos_perdas
    FOR EACH ROW
    EXECUTE FUNCTION update_eventos_perdas_updated_at();
